command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

GV=$(gffcompare --version 2>&1 | awk 'NR==1{print $2}')
echo "== score the assembly against the planted annotation with gffcompare =="
gffcompare -r truth.gtf -o gffcmp assembled.gtf > gffcmp.log 2>&1
sed -n '1,30p' gffcmp.stats

lvl(){ awk -v k="$1" -F'[:|]' '$0 ~ k {gsub(/ /,"",$2); gsub(/ /,"",$3); print $2" "$3; exit}' gffcmp.stats; }
read -r BS BP  < <(lvl 'Base level')
read -r ES EP  < <(lvl 'Exon level')
read -r IS IP  < <(lvl 'Intron level')
read -r CS CP  < <(lvl 'Intron chain level')
MIC=$(awk '/Matching intron chains:/{print $NF}' gffcmp.stats)
num(){ awk -v k="$1" '$0 ~ k { for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i ~ /^[0-9]+\/[0-9]+$/){ split($i,a,"/"); print a[1]; exit } }' gffcmp.stats; }
MISI=$(num 'Missed introns:')
NOVI=$(num 'Novel introns:')
CC=$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1{print $3; exit}' gffcmp.assembled.gtf.tmap)
QLEN=$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1{print $10; exit}' gffcmp.assembled.gtf.tmap)
RLEN=$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1{print $12; exit}' gffcmp.assembled.gtf.tmap)

# structure must be perfect in BOTH directions -- nothing missed, nothing invented
test "$IS" = "100.0" && test "$IP" = "100.0" || { echo "intron level $IS/$IP, expected 100.0/100.0"; exit 1; }
test "$CS" = "100.0" && test "$CP" = "100.0" || { echo "intron chain level $CS/$CP"; exit 1; }
test "$ES" = "100.0" && test "$EP" = "100.0" || { echo "exon level $ES/$EP"; exit 1; }
test "$MIC"  = "1" || { echo "matching intron chains $MIC"; exit 1; }
test "$MISI" = "0" || { echo "$MISI missed introns"; exit 1; }
test "$NOVI" = "0" || { echo "$NOVI novel introns"; exit 1; }
test "$CC"   = "=" || { echo "class code $CC, expected '=' (complete intron-chain match)"; exit 1; }
# precision 100 everywhere means StringTie invented nothing; base sensitivity is the ONE
# number that should be below 100, and it is exactly the trimmed length.
test "$BP" = "100.0" || { echo "base precision $BP -- StringTie assembled bases outside the gene"; exit 1; }
EXP=$(awk -v q="$QLEN" -v r="$RLEN" 'BEGIN{printf "%.1f", 100*q/r}')
test "$BS" = "$EXP" || { echo "base sensitivity $BS != 100*$QLEN/$RLEN = $EXP"; exit 1; }

{
printf 'Transcript assembly scored against the planted annotation (gffcompare)\n'
printf 'gffcompare_version\t%s\n' "$GV"
printf 'intron_level\t%s / %s   (assert 100.0 / 100.0 -- EXACT, both directions)\n' "$IS" "$IP"
printf 'intron_chain_level\t%s / %s   (assert 100.0 / 100.0)\n' "$CS" "$CP"
printf 'exon_level\t%s / %s   (assert 100.0 / 100.0)\n' "$ES" "$EP"
printf 'matching_intron_chains\t%s   (assert 1)\n' "$MIC"
printf 'missed_introns\t%s   (assert 0)\n' "$MISI"
printf 'novel_introns\t%s   (assert 0 -- nothing invented)\n' "$NOVI"
printf 'class_code\t%s   (assert "=" -- complete intron-chain match)\n' "$CC"
printf 'base_precision\t%s   (assert 100.0 -- no assembled base lies outside the gene)\n' "$BP"
printf 'base_sensitivity\t%s   (the ONLY metric below 100, and it EQUALS 100*%s/%s)\n' "$BS" "$QLEN" "$RLEN"
printf 'note\tevery STRUCTURAL metric is 100%%; the single shortfall is %s bp of 5-prime terminus,\n' "$(( RLEN - QLEN ))"
printf 'note\tso base sensitivity is not a defect to chase -- it is the trim, measured.\n'
} | tee smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
